provenance.sha_source: GitHub contents API — this is UPSTREAM'S OWN git blob identifier for those bytes. It is deliberately NOT a digest we computed over what we wrote: a self-computed hash proves only that we hashed our own bytes, so a mistaken or malicious edit that updated both the file and the digest would pass.

notes: FORK NOTE (2026-08-15). upstream_repo is now EHA-Clinics/elek, a PUBLIC soft fork of selimozten/elek off its main at d1d1366c. It must stay public: six of the thirteen consumers live in the eHealthAfrica org and can only resolve a cross-org action with the default GITHUB_TOKEN if it is. The fork carries five patches, each on its own branch so it stays offerable upstream: exclude_paths (real path filtering in the packer), one retry per failed required lens, priority_source_extensions (opt-in, default off), per-lens prompt-budget telemetry in review_summary_json, and the actor-gate fix that stops allowed_bots silently denying every human review. Rebase onto upstream rather than diverging further.

EHAC-2231 RE-VENDOR (2026-08-18), eha-v1.3.0 -> eha-v1.3.1. The pin moved to stop `timeout` consuming the outer retry and to honour exclude_paths on the solo prompt path. Neither patch touched src/review/diff-context.ts; re-fetched at the new ref and compared byte for byte, identical, upstream blob SHA unchanged. Goldens therefore move only in their recorded upstream_commit. Re-verified rather than assumed.

EHAC-2231 RE-VENDOR (2026-08-18), eha-v1.2.1 -> eha-v1.3.0. The pin moved for the stall watchdog, the typed retry and the summary finalizer; src/review/diff-context.ts was NOT touched by any of the three patches. Re-fetched at the new ref and compared byte for byte: identical, and upstream's own blob SHA is unchanged at 64441e769de897ed0b371e2321657fdbe80b2e87. That is why the goldens under fixtures/golden/ are unchanged apart from the recorded upstream_commit, and why the pr-3515.diff truncation proof still truncates. Both were re-verified rather than assumed: an unchanged packer is a CLAIM until the bytes are compared.

The vendored file is UPSTREAM BYTES AND NOTHING ELSE. It carries no local header, no lint suppression and no formatting pass, because any of those would break the byte-identity that upstream_blob_sha asserts. Provenance lives here, in this sibling file, for exactly that reason.

COUPLING NOTE for whoever takes the deferred elek version move (EHAC-2103 / D-04): bumping selimozten/elek in .github/workflows/ai-code-review.yml invalidates FOUR things at once, and they must move in one change — (1) this manifest's upstream_commit and upstream_blob_sha, plus a re-fetch of the vendored file; (2) ELEK_REF_VERIFIED, which is re-exported from this manifest by elek-prompt-budget.mjs and asserted against the workflow pin; (3) every file under fixtures/golden/, which is frozen at this pin and must be regenerated by generate-goldens.mjs; (4) the pr-3515.diff truncation proof in coverage-gate-tests.yml — a newer packer may stop truncating that fixture, at which point the non-vacuity step would pass for the wrong reason. Check (4) by hand; the other three are asserted.

STATED LIMITATION: none of the offline assertions in elek-prompt-budget.test.mjs proves that the GitHub Action executing at runtime uses these semantics. The only link is upstream_commit equalling the workflow's action pin, and that is a link by COMMIT IDENTITY, not by execution. It is written here rather than implied away.
